i am non-EU student and im married with a romanian citizen, do i have same rights for admission? if i later become romanian citizen what i have to do and which documents do i need for my application
reference:
Yes. Non-EU candidates who hold a Romanian residence permit as 'family member of a Romanian citizen' (for example obtained through marriage) or a long-term residence permit have the same study rights, including financial rights, as Romanian citizens at the West University of Timișoara. If you later obtain a new status (Romanian citizen, EU citizen, refugee, or a form of subsidiary protection), you must notify the DRI and the faculty where you are enrolled within a maximum of 30 days of obtaining the new status, so that your financial regime can be changed, additional documents can be issued, or you can take part in a new admission session in the following academic year, as the case may be.

For the application, third-country citizens submit their candidate dossier to UVT's Department of International Relations through the dedicated online admission platform (admiterenonue.uvt.ro). Applications for the following academic year can be filed until 1 August each year (15 September for graduates of the Romanian language preparatory programme and for candidates who pass their final university exams at UVT in the September session). Enrolment is possible only after obtaining the Letter of Acceptance for Studies issued by the Ministry of Education and Research (MEC-DGRIAE) at the university's request; candidates must hold a baccalaureate diploma or equivalent, and the list of recognised high-school diplomas is set out in Annex 1 to the methodology.

The documents required for the bachelor's admission dossier are: (1) the application for the Letter of Acceptance, completed in all fields, with a photo; (2) the documents certifying previous studies (baccalaureate diploma or equivalent) — copy plus legalised and authenticated translation; (3) the certificate attesting passing the baccalaureate for current-year graduates, if applicable; (4) transcripts (foi matricole) and the analytical curriculum, if equivalence of study periods is requested; (5) the certificate of completion of the Romanian language preparatory programme or a language proficiency certificate, as applicable; (6) the birth certificate — copy with authenticated translation; (7) a copy of the document attesting stable residence abroad, if applicable; (8) a copy of the passport valid for at least 6 months after the Letter of Acceptance is issued; (9) a medical certificate (in an international circulation language) no older than 90 days; (10) the marriage certificate, if needed to prove a name change; (11) the completed personal data form; (12) parental or guardian consent for residence for study purposes, if the applicant is a minor; and (13) proof of payment of the 100 EUR dossier-processing fee, unless paid through the admission platform. The fee is not charged to persons who prove with supporting documents that they benefit from a form of international protection. Documents issued abroad must be authenticated: study documents from states party to the Hague Apostille Convention must bear the Apostille; for other states they must be supralegalised or accompanied by an authenticity certificate. Supralegalisation is not required where an exemption is provided by law, by an international treaty to which Romania is a party, or on the basis of reciprocity.

reference: At the Faculty of Informatics, the admission average is N = (max{N1, N2} + N3) / 2: the maximum of the baccalaureate average (N1) and the best grade obtained at the Mathematics or Informatics written baccalaureate exam (N2, considered 4 if no such exam was taken) is averaged with the grade at the written admission test (N3) - each side getting 50%. At the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics, the formula is N = 0.7 x max(N1, N2) + 0.3 x N3: the baccalaureate side carries a 70% weight and the written admission test only 30%, where N2 is the best grade among the Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or Informatics baccalaureate exams (also 4 if none was taken). Both faculties keep the minimum general admission average of 6.00, require that no contest grade be below 5.00, and compute the average to two decimals without rounding.

user_input: do the law faculty and the faculty of letters history and theology handle appeals against admission results the same way?
reference: Yes, with one small difference in publication. At both the Faculty of Law and the Faculty of Letters, History and Theology, appeals against the admission process can be filed within the deadline set in the admission calendar, by e-mail (admitere.fd@e-uvt.ro at the Faculty of Law, admitere.lift@e-uvt.ro at FLIFT); appeals are analyzed by the faculty's contestation commission and results are published within at most 24 hours after the appeal deadline. disciplină  specificată  de  candidat  în  formularul  de  înscriere. $$N = ( 7 / 1 0 ) \, x \, N _ { 1 } + ( 3 / 1 0 ) \, x \, N _ { 3 }$$

(6) Pentru candidații români de pretutindeni calcularea mediei de admitere (N) se face după formula:

reference: Under Law no. 277/2010, a single-parent family consists of a single person and their dependent children living together, where the single person is in one of the following situations: unmarried (proven by a certificate of celibacy); widowed; divorced; whose spouse has been declared missing by a court decision; whose spouse is in preventive arrest for more than 30 days or serving a custodial sentence and does not contribute to the children's support; or who has been appointed as a tutor or has had one or more children entrusted or placed in their care, and is in one of the situations under a)–c). At the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics, candidates with one or both parents deceased, as well as those from single-parent families, are exempt from the application fee.

user_input: What are the admission fees for the Faculty of Arts and Design at UVT, and which categories of candidates are exempted from the application fee, as per the decisions of Senatul UVT?
reference: The application fee for the admission contest is 200 lei, and the registration fee is 250 lei, in accordance with the decisions of the Senate of UVT.
